adam smith.fact: Scottish economist and philosopher (1723–1790), author of The Wealth of Nations and a leading figure of the Scottish Enlightenment.

abraham lincoln.fact: 16th President of the United States (1861–65), led the Union during the American Civil War and issued the Emancipation Proclamation.
